items.title: GTA 6 Runs Better On Xbox Series X Than Base PS5
items.summary: Digital Foundry testing found the Series X holds the 30fps target more consistently than the base PS5, which has more frame drops into the 20s in crowded areas, while the PS5 Pro is the best-performing console overall.

items.title: GTA 6 "hit Call of Duty HARD," analyst reports, with a 42% drop in daily players
items.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates Call of Duty's daily active users fell 42%, from 7.5 million to 4.4 million, after GTA 6 launched.

items.title: Unofficial GTA 6 PC port scrapped as Rockstar allegedly takes down Discord server
items.summary: The 15-year-old lead of Project Leonida quit and said Rockstar had taken down the project's Discord server, hours after the game was shown booting on PC.

items.title: GTA 6 PC version is close, modders say after Cyberleek releases executable: "The game almost boots"
items.summary: Cyberleek released the Xbox build's executable on November 23, and Project Leonida modders say the game almost boots, though it isn't playable on PC yet.

items.title: GTA 6 PS5 Sales Near 39 Million & Obliterate an All-Time PlayStation Record
items.summary: Sony says more than 39 million unique players have launched GTA 6 on PS5, making it the biggest launch in PlayStation history, with 683 million hours played.

items.title: GTA 6 players found a '60 fps glitch', but it's too unstable to stop me from wishing it was on PC already
items.summary: An Xbox Quick Resume and refresh-rate trick lifts the 30 fps cap, but Digital Foundry measured only about 36 fps on average.

items.title: Hacker behind GTA 6 leak released as judge says "don't let this happen again"
items.summary: Arion Kurtaj, the hacker behind the 2022 GTA 6 leak, has been released from prison, and a judge warned him not to try something like it again.

items.title: GTA 6 update gives players losing progress to crashes a lifeline
items.summary: Rockstar's first post-launch patch, 01.002.002, fixes crashes, autosaving, phone calls, the Wanted Level bug and the weather that rarely changed, but it leaves the first-person and 60fps glitches alone.

items.title: GTA 6 Is Approaching An Absurd New Sales Milestone, Report Says
items.summary: Alinea Analytics estimates 44.9 million copies sold in the first weekend, about $4 billion in revenue and 40.8 million players logged in on Sunday.

items.title: Final piece of claimed GTA 6 leak set to arrive today — and there's hope it could mean Rockstar launches the PC port sooner
items.summary: Cyberleek says it will release the missing executable for its leaked 209GB Xbox build on November 23, which could speed up unofficial PC emulation and might push Rockstar to bring its own PC port forward.
